chapters.summary: Peter urges believers to give all diligence to growing in the knowledge of Christ, pursuing spiritual growth, and confirming their calling and election so that they will never fall.
keyPoints: God has given us exceeding great and precious promises of life and godliness, that through them we may escape the corruption in the world and become partakers of the divine nature.
We are to give all diligence, adding to our faith virtue, knowledge, self-control, and more, so that we bear abundant fruit.
Make your calling and election sure, and an entrance will be ministered to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of Christ.
chapters.application: Spend time each day in Scripture and prayer, exercising faith and virtue, so that your life continually grows in grace. Be confident in God's calling, and live out a glorious testimony.

chapters.summary: Peter warns believers to beware of false teachers, who follow their own covetousness and deceive people with feigned words - but the Lord will judge them, while the godly will be delivered.
keyPoints: False teachers secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Lord who bought them, and bring swift destruction upon themselves.
Through covetousness they exploit believers with feigned words, but their judgment does not linger and their damnation does not slumber.
The Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to keep the unjust under punishment until the day of judgment.
chapters.application: Stay alert and discern what you hear taught, keeping far from greed and false teaching. Trust firmly in the Lord - he will keep you from temptation and give you the strength to overcome.

chapters.summary: Peter reminds believers that the Lord will surely come again, though the day is unknown, and urges them to live godly lives while waiting for the new heavens and new earth.
keyPoints: In the last days scoffers will come, walking after their own lusts and questioning the promise of the Lord's coming.
With the Lord a day is as a thousand years, and he is longsuffering, waiting for people to repent - but the day of the Lord will come as a thief.
Believers are to live holy and godly lives, growing in the grace and knowledge of the Lord, and guarding against being led away by error.
chapters.application: As we wait for the Lord's return, let us live holy and godly lives, hold fast to hope, and diligently pursue growth in Christ, without being led astray by the world.
